intent: Demonstrate shared component APIs and theme-specific tokens through an experimental IconButton example in the initial Horizon RFC v1.0, preserving Sunrise defaults. AI Workspace/styleguide wrappers inform optional shapes and variants; the local theme tokens record proposed visual choices. This draft supports discussion of the broader theme and does not approve the design or release.

states.expected: Sunrise keeps its existing secondary/normal appearance; Horizon demonstrates scoped proposals for primary blue, neutral secondary and typography.

states.trigger: Render default and rounded at each size
states.expected: Default retains the theme radius (Sunrise 8px, Horizon 12px); rounded is explicit pill/circle, never a theme-wide default.
Typed heights 32/36/44px. Compact 32 is a styleguide-informed proposal; normal and large retain the existing component scale.
Existing variants remain available; success and outline translate application tones into the shared discriminated enum.
Visible token-driven focus and exactly one activation per key press with an accessible name.
Disabled semantics block focus and actions.

states.trigger: Activate Send message, which enters loading
states.expected: Busy state retains the action name and blocks repeated activation.

impact.summary: Add shape=default|rounded, size=small (32px), variant=success|outline to the shared Button API inherited by IconButton. Existing Sunrise default styles remain unchanged. Horizon default Button styles gain proposed blue, neutral and typography tokens; no universal rounded default and no icon-size change. Shared tests exercise both API consumers. Horizon button focus rings use stronger semantic colors for visibility; other components and Sunrise keep their existing focus tokens. Horizon text buttons hug content via auto minimum width; Sunrise retains its existing 100px minimum. Optional Button tokens fall back at each CSS consumer to the existing semantic tokens in Sunrise; no root aliases capture and break local overrides.
impact.consumerAction: Existing consumers require no change. Horizon consumers select its complete stylesheet in an isolated document. Replace wrapper data-sl-shape/tone usage with shape and variant; tone=success maps variant=success and tone=toolbarOutline maps variant=outline with size=small. This remains branch-only RFC code pending acceptance.

openQuestions: Review the proposed geometry, colors, typography and interaction states as part of the initial theme vocabulary.
Approve accessibility-adjusted success colors, compact 32px and outline as reusable shared variants.
Review canonical visual baselines, screen reader behavior and full package coverage before release.

evidence.description: Local targeted Vitest run passed 10 tests across Button/IconButton; durable evidence receipt and package coverage are pending.
HorizonApi stories exercise Tab, Enter, Space, loading and disabled blocking; browser execution results must be recorded.
Show matrices cover seven variants, three sizes and two shapes, enabled/loading/disabled, plus actual focus/hover samples. Canonical reviewed baselines remain pending.
Computed success contrast 5.33:1 and proposed primary contrast 5.32:1; browser axe, focus contrast and manual assistive-technology review still required.
Scoped tsc --noEmit covering Button/IconButton runtime, stories and tests passed. Full package tsc reports 8 existing errors outside this scope; the full type gate remains unresolved.
No claim of the constitutional 80% public-package coverage floor; measure in CI.
All-theme token audit and scoped policy/lint checks pass locally. Compare Sunrise defaults and Horizon proposal in isolated real React documents; canonical review remains pending.
